Groups of 10+ rooms get a dedicated coordinator and a 10% rate; the event spaces seat 120 banquet-style or 200 standing. Weddings run three packages — Intimate, Classic, Grand — covering the ballroom or the waterfront terrace, in-house catering from Vela’s kitchen, and a preferred-vendor list for florists and photographers; quote a package, never a firm price, without confirming the date with the events team.
